name: jev
title: JEV
description: Describe a file, folder, or email in plain English and JEV finds it — instant Spotlight-speed results, semantically ranked by Jev (TypeSafe System One).
author: bobby

commands.name: find-file
commands.title: Find File or Folder
commands.subtitle: JEV
commands.description: Describe a file or folder and JEV finds and opens it.

commands.name: find-email
commands.title: Find Email
commands.subtitle: JEV
commands.description: Describe an email and JEV finds it in your Gmail.

preferences.name: jevApiKey
preferences.title: Jev API Key
preferences.description: Your TypeSafe Jev API key. Stored securely in the macOS Keychain by Raycast.

preferences.name: searchPaths

preferences.description: Optional comma-separated folders to limit file search to. Leave blank to search your whole home folder.

preferences.name: googleClientId

preferences.description: Only needed for Find Email. Create a Desktop OAuth client in Google Cloud (see README) and paste its Client ID here.
